s01.masked_text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our electricity officer [PHONE]. Thank you.

tactics.exact_span: your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM
tactics.explanation: It threatens to cut off an essential utility service if the reader does not act.
It pressures the reader to respond right away without verifying the claim.
It invokes an official-sounding role to make the demand seem legitimate.

s02.masked_text: প্ৰিয় গ্ৰাহক, আপোনাৰ বিদ্যুৎ সংযোগ আজি নিশা ৯:৩০ বজাত বিচ্ছিন্ন কৰা হ'ব। বিল আপডেট নাই। লগে লগে এই নম্বৰত যোগাযোগ কৰক [PHONE]

tactics.exact_span: বিদ্যুৎ সংযোগ আজি নিশা ৯:৩০ বজাত বিচ্ছিন্ন কৰা হ'ব
tactics.explanation: Threatens immediate disconnection of the electricity supply tonight.
Pressures the recipient to act immediately without verifying.

s07.masked_text: Your electricity bill payment failed. Download APDCL Bill Update app to avoid disconnection: http://bill-update-apdcl.site/APDCL_Update.apk

tactics.explanation: Threatens electricity disconnection to pressure the reader into acting.
Uses a non-official domain mimicking APDCL to distribute an APK file.
Claims to be from the official electricity utility company.
